hold_text: Companion to the tip pre-scrub (row BALANCE-TIP-PRESCRUB). Text-only removal of account-balance literals from 5 research queue units, 1 lever file, 1 programme file and 2 historical pr-landing records. No field other than prose/string values changes; every file still parses. Held because pr-landing-guard (R5, R12) refuses self-landing for pre-registered research files and landing records. A human merge, before the purge freeze, is all it needs.
why: Removes balance literals so the account-balance history purge leaves the tip tree identical.
